theory: The claim that no derivative sign change necessarily means a horizontal point of inflection is too general: a function can be constant near a stationary point without an inflection. Qualify this statement to the isolated stationary points of the polynomial examples being discussed, or state that unchanged gradient sign rules out a turning point without asserting an inflection in every case.
